title: Fedora Ron
overview: FEDORA RON follows a detective named Fedora Ron (Joseph Curran) as he steps out of retirement at the behest of his mentor Captain Tracy (Ron Barba) to take on his arch nemesis Tophat Don (Malcom Xavier Johnson). With the help of his new partner Monique (Jiana Casazza) Fedora Ron will take on the entire Tophat Clan as he works his way up to get his revenge on Tophat Don.
